page.layout: One page of text, all in one column. Above: the closing paragraph of a preface, with a dateline and signature centred. Below: a woodcut ornament (not text). No running head, page number or catchword.

main_text.p: rine forte,aut euentu, dicere non aufim. Periculum tamen subire animus est , nec me (sat scio) poenituerit vnquam, amicis hominibus, dum meos in vniuersum Iuris corpus Commentarios absoluo , praecida-neum hoc opus,maioris operis, meíque in rempublicam, posterósque animi si-gnum[?] obtulisse. Datum ex Musæo x i. Kalend. Mart. Anno 1583.

page.notes: The first word is cut off at the left edge of the printed area: "rine" is read as the end of a word, probably "ruine", but the first letter is not clearly legible, so the fragment is kept as it stands. The dateline "x i." and the year "1583" are set in the centred lines of the original. "animi si-gnum" is a line-end break, and the initial letter of "signum" is doubtful (it could be "fi"). The ornament below the text is a woodcut of a cherub with fruit and scrolls and is not transcribed. Stains and show-through at the left edge are not printed text.
